headline: Godcrofts Remains War’s Busiest Strategic Front
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger records continued upheaval on several fronts, though the tempo has shifted. Godcrofts has risen to 49 base events in 24 hours, including five in the latest two-hour window, and remains divided nine Warden to none Colonial only in ownership? No—its nine bases are all Warden-held despite the repeated turnover. Fisherman’s Row has reached 30 events, with three in six hours, but its nine bases are now Colonial-held. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each stand at 31 events; both remain split, Stlican six Warden to three Colonial and Stonecradle five to four, with fresh activity in the latest six hours. Weathered Expanse has eased from the previous edition’s higher count to 32 events, yet its four Warden, four Colonial and one neutral bases remain a broad contest, with four events in two hours. Linn Mercy is newly prominent at 16 events, including two in the latest two hours, while ten Colonial bases and one neutral position mark an unsettled line. Callahan’s Passage has gone quieter, recording three daily events and none recently.
